sn56.27:1.3: dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ dukkhasamudayo ariyasaccaṃ dukkhanirodho ariyasaccaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ.
sn56.27:1.4: imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri ariyasaccāni tathāni avitathāni anaññathāni
sn56.27:2.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
